name: Biscuit
description: Beagle, black, tan and white, small, patterned harness
markings: White tip on her tail, black saddle across her back

updates.note: Found in a shed on Hollin Close after a neighbour heard her. Home, fed and asleep.
Seen by the allotments behind Station Lane, early morning. Heading towards the railway path.
Slipped her collar during the evening walk near the Elm Road playground.

foundNote: Biscuit was found on Wednesday morning, two streets away in a neighbour's shed: hungry, muddy and fine. Thank you to everyone who looked, called and shared.
